extension.summary: Classic TV — 24/7 themed channels synced to wall-clock time
extension.description: Classic TV recreates the experience of watching cable television circa 1990–2010 on a real CRT. Themed channels play continuously, synchronized to wall-clock time. Channel schedule is served by the ClassicTV Jellyfin plugin. Playback is delegated to the Jellyfin Kodi addon — Classic TV handles only channel navigation and overlays.
